title: Pre-retrieval access control and redaction
checks: A claims agent sees claims documents up to their clearance
An auditor sees across departments, within clearance
An intern sees nothing above internal
Another company's documents are never visible
all('D6' not in visible(u, DOCS) for u in USERS.values())
